programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After an argument, Gladys Kravitz locks her husband out of their home. The Stephens invite Abner to spend the night at their place. Later, when it appears that Abner, using all his privileges as a guest, is more than satisfied with the arrangements and is making no effort to return to his own home, Darrin demands that Samantha take action. Not only is Samantha unsuccessful in all her attempts to effect a reconciliation, but she learns that Gladys wants a divorce. When all else fails, Samantha gets the idea of using sleep therapy to reunite the Kravitzes. Feeling that one of the happiest days of her life is the day a man proposes marriage, and a woman accepts him, Samantha projects Gladys and Abner in their dreams back to that day. Then she awakens them and each begins looking for the other. Later, as Samantha and Darrin look forward to spending an evening at home alone, the Kravitzes arrive to celebrate their reunion.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: As Darrin naps in the living room, Endora points out some of the unfortunate details of his face. Samantha at first protests when her mother, using witchcraft, changes Darrin's looks but then adds some touches of her own. Awakening, Darrin demands an explanation. Samantha can't explain why she and Endora were changing his features, and Darrin begins to worry. As the obsession grows, Samantha decides to build up her husband's ego. Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: In every way, Samantha and Darrin Stephens are a perfectly normal, all-American couple, except for one small detail...Samantha's a witch!

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha and Endora discover the culinary delights of Mario's restaurant. Mario tells them he is going broke because he refuses to sell pizza. Samantha learns that Darrin's agency has a new client, Linton Baldwin, the owner of a large chain of pizza parlors. When Samantha uses witchcraft to get a huge newspaper ad for Mario, and Endora inserts a plug for him on Baldwin's TV program, Baldwin tells Larry Tate he is cancelling his account and signing with the agency handling Mario's restaurant. Realizing Darrin's career is in jeopardy, Samantha persuades Endora to help save the Baldwin account for Darrin. They lay out a spectacular advertising campaign for Baldwin and give the credit to Darrin's agency. Not only does Baldwin ask Darrin's agency to keep his account, but Mario's restaurant becomes a great success.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Almost as determined as Endora to break up Samantha's marriage to a mere mortal, Samantha's cousin Edgar, an elf, begins playing pranks on Darrin. Darrin's agency has been trying to hold onto the Shelley Shoe account. Edgar, invisible to all, plagues Darrin in his office. Darrin is sure Endora is working on him again, and has difficulty persuading Larry Tate to let him present the new campaign to Mr. Shelley. At the sales meeting, Fred Schulwiler, as unscrupulous competitor, almost gets the account when he makes it appear that Darrin is trying to make Mr. Shelley look ridiculous. When Samantha convinces Edgar that she is very happy with Darrin, he switches his attentions to Schulwiler. Before Edgar is through, Schulwiler has lost all chance of landing the Shelley account. Darrin, coming up with an advertising campaign featuring an elf not unlike Edgar, ties up the account for his firm.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Phoning from London, the Tates inform the Stephens that their governess has been taken ill. They ask Darrin and Samantha to care for the child until they return. Gladys Kravitz sees them leaving the house and returning with a baby. Assuming the Stephens' baby has arrived, Gladys congratulates Maurice, Samantha's father, on the birth of his grandson. Maurice is shocked to find the baby is not being taught witchcraft. He flies away with the child to the Warlock's Club in London. Meanwhile, the Tates arrive at the local airport. Darrin tries to stall while Samantha finds their baby. In London, after many tests, the Warlocks tell Maurice the baby "hasn't got it." Nanny Witch adds that the baby is a mortal like the father. At the Stephens home, Samantha and Darrin are about to tell the Tates their baby is missing, when Maurice arrives with the child. Maurice's pride is restored when Samantha tells him her baby is not due for several months. Arriving with a present, Gladys is told to wait until Samantha's baby is born. Before vanishing through a wall, Maurice hands Gladys a martini. Watching Gladys down it, Samantha hopes she will not remember what she has seen and heard.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha arranges a meeting between Darrin and her mother which she hopes will settle their differences. A series of minor accidents sets Darrin and Endora accusing each other of being practical pokers. Realizing someone else is responsible, Samantha uncovers a serving dish and reveals her Uncle Arthur, who dotes on practical jokes. Infuriated by Darrin's uproarious appreciation of Uncle Arthur, Endora plants a Beatles hairdo on Darrin. Darrin refuses Uncle Arthur's offer to teach him some magic so he can stand up to Endora, until he is knocked out by an accident in the office. Certain Endora is at work, Darrin accepts Uncle Arthur's offer. Following Uncle Arthur's weird instructions, Darrin tries to make Endora disappear. When she does not, Darrin realizes he has been the victim of another of Uncle Arthur's pranks. Samantha enlists Endora and Darrin in a plan to cure Uncle Arthur. Arthur is incredulous when Darrin says he can turn Endora into a parrot. When Endora becomes a parrot (through her own witchcraft), Arthur pleads with Darrin to remove the spell. Endora then returns to normal and demands that Arthur stop his practical jokes, which Uncle Arthur accepts. Before leaving, Uncle Arthur gives Endora a pair of opera glasses. When she lowers them she has two black eyes.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Take Two Aspirins And Half A Pint Of Porpoise Milk
programme.desc: While Howard Norton shows the Stephens a black Peruvian rose, Samantha tells Darrin she feels ill and has lost her witchcraft. The doctor tells Samantha that her health is perfect. Gladys sees the doctor's car and brings some chicken soup. When square green spots appear on Samantha's face, Abner is sure the chicken soup is responsible. Aunt Clara arrives and lists the ingredients for a remedy. Darrin buys all the ingre-dients, except an ostrich feather, from Mr. Trigby, who caters to witches. Trying to take the ostrich feather from a woman's hat, Darrin is arrested but later released. Aunt Clara, after using witchcraft to produce an ostrich, tells Darrin she still needs four petals from a black Peruvian rose. Darrin is arrested when he tries to steal the petals from Mr. Norton's precious bloom. Finally, Aunt Clara concocts the remedy and cures Samantha. Later, Mr. Norton is astonished when he sees a window box filled with black Peruvian roses Samantha has produced by twitching her nose.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Despite Endora's demand that Samantha accompany her to a witches celebration of Halloween, Darrin insists that his wife stay at home to entertain Louise and Larry Tate, Jack Rogers, a client, and his wife, Phyllis. Disguising herself as a child in a gypsy costume, Endora hexes Darrin with a spell that will gradually turn him into a werewolf. When Samantha demands that her mother remove the spell, Endora tells her she can't remember the words. After the guests arrive, Darrin is forced to go out of the room from time to time to shave off the werewolf hair which is beginning to grow all over him. Finally, when dinner arrives, Darrin starts snarling and jumps through as open window. Larry and Jack, sure that Darrin is in werewolf costume, bring him back into the house. Darrin, fearful of what he might do, gets Samantha to lock him in the call closet. Endora reappears in a high fashion evening gown. When Samantha tells her she is behaving exactly like the stereotype of a witch she hates so much, Endora returns Darrin to his normal self. Later, Jack, certain that Endora is also garbed for Halloween, compliments her on her bizarre outfit. Endora gestures, and a lion's tail appears on Jack. Endora tells Darrin Jack won't notice it until he tries to remove his trousers.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry Tate invites Samantha and Darrin to a buffet for prospective client Charles Barlow. When they complain about the condition of their clothes, Aunt Clara uses magic to produce a dress for Samantha and a new suit for Darrin, who invites her along to the affair. Once there, Aunt Clara removes a fire hydrant so Darrin can park. At the party, Samantha's dress begins to vanish and Aunt Clara's other magical efforts begin to disintegrate. Agreeing to drop Barlow at his hotel, Darrin finds the hydrant has returned to its place beside the car. As a policeman approaches, Darrin's outer garments disappear. Aunt Clara's efforts to help result in chaos, with Barlow, Darrin and the policeman dressed in each other's clothing. Barlow leaves, vowing Darrin will never get his account, and still in his underwear, Darrin is jailed with Montague, an alcoholic. After Aunt Clara's attempts to clothe Darrin fail, Samantha goes to his cell with a suit of clothes. When Judge Crosetti hears Montague's mad account of a change of clothing in the cell, he releases Darrin. Larry Tate, having heard Barlow's equally wild story, decides his company is not interested in handling his account.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. Samantha tells Darrin she'll need lots of love to keep the hoofers away.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. When Samantha wonders whether the Stephens ' baby will look like his father, Endora turns Darrin into an eight-year-old. Returned to normal, Darrin goes to his office. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Aunt Clara tells Samantha and Endora she is hiding from warlock Hedley Partridge, because she fears her old beau will discover her magic no longer works. Seeing in Hedley a husband for Aunt Clara, who has become a problem, Endora invites him to the Stephens home. Samantha decides to make sure Aunt Clara's tricks work. Unaware of this, Aunt Clara is sure her gift is returned when she matches all of Hedley's tricks. When Samantha goes out of the room, Aunt Clara tries to follow Hedley's ro-mantic suggestion that they turn themselves into nightingales, but Hedley becomes an animal, while Aunt Clara's lower half disappears. Gladys Kravitz, who has become hysterical watching the strange happenings, drags Abner over to the Stephens house. When Samantha returns Aunt Clara and Hedley to normal, Aunt Clara is crushed to learn that Samantha helped her all along. Gladys skeptically accepts Abner's explanation that Hedley's magic was performed with the aid of wires. Aunt Clara and Hedley each admit that none of their tricks work as well as they used to. Promising to return, Hedley leaves. Aunt Clara tells Samantha his parting gift a rhinestone doorknob, is more precious than an engagement ring.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: In every way, Samantha and Darrin Stephens are a perfectly normal, all-American couple, except for one small detail...Samantha's a witch!

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha and Endora discover the culinary delights of Mario's restaurant. Mario tells them he is going broke because he refuses to sell pizza. Samantha learns that Darrin's agency has a new client, Linton Baldwin, the owner of a large chain of pizza parlors. When Samantha uses witchcraft to get a huge newspaper ad for Mario, and Endora inserts a plug for him on Baldwin's TV program, Baldwin tells Larry Tate he is cancelling his account and signing with the agency handling Mario's restaurant. Realizing Darrin's career is in jeopardy, Samantha persuades Endora to help save the Baldwin account for Darrin. They lay out a spectacular advertising campaign for Baldwin and give the credit to Darrin's agency. Not only does Baldwin ask Darrin's agency to keep his account, but Mario's restaurant becomes a great success.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Almost as determined as Endora to break up Samantha's marriage to a mere mortal, Samantha's cousin Edgar, an elf, begins playing pranks on Darrin. Darrin's agency has been trying to hold onto the Shelley Shoe account. Edgar, invisible to all, plagues Darrin in his office. Darrin is sure Endora is working on him again, and has difficulty persuading Larry Tate to let him present the new campaign to Mr. Shelley. At the sales meeting, Fred Schulwiler, as unscrupulous competitor, almost gets the account when he makes it appear that Darrin is trying to make Mr. Shelley look ridiculous. When Samantha convinces Edgar that she is very happy with Darrin, he switches his attentions to Schulwiler. Before Edgar is through, Schulwiler has lost all chance of landing the Shelley account. Darrin, coming up with an advertising campaign featuring an elf not unlike Edgar, ties up the account for his firm.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Phoning from London, the Tates inform the Stephens that their governess has been taken ill. They ask Darrin and Samantha to care for the child until they return. Gladys Kravitz sees them leaving the house and returning with a baby. Assuming the Stephens' baby has arrived, Gladys congratulates Maurice, Samantha's father, on the birth of his grandson. Maurice is shocked to find the baby is not being taught witchcraft. He flies away with the child to the Warlock's Club in London. Meanwhile, the Tates arrive at the local airport. Darrin tries to stall while Samantha finds their baby. In London, after many tests, the Warlocks tell Maurice the baby "hasn't got it." Nanny Witch adds that the baby is a mortal like the father. At the Stephens home, Samantha and Darrin are about to tell the Tates their baby is missing, when Maurice arrives with the child. Maurice's pride is restored when Samantha tells him her baby is not due for several months. Arriving with a present, Gladys is told to wait until Samantha's baby is born. Before vanishing through a wall, Maurice hands Gladys a martini. Watching Gladys down it, Samantha hopes she will not remember what she has seen and heard.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha arranges a meeting between Darrin and her mother which she hopes will settle their differences. A series of minor accidents sets Darrin and Endora accusing each other of being practical pokers. Realizing someone else is responsible, Samantha uncovers a serving dish and reveals her Uncle Arthur, who dotes on practical jokes. Infuriated by Darrin's uproarious appreciation of Uncle Arthur, Endora plants a Beatles hairdo on Darrin. Darrin refuses Uncle Arthur's offer to teach him some magic so he can stand up to Endora, until he is knocked out by an accident in the office. Certain Endora is at work, Darrin accepts Uncle Arthur's offer. Following Uncle Arthur's weird instructions, Darrin tries to make Endora disappear. When she does not, Darrin realizes he has been the victim of another of Uncle Arthur's pranks. Samantha enlists Endora and Darrin in a plan to cure Uncle Arthur. Arthur is incredulous when Darrin says he can turn Endora into a parrot. When Endora becomes a parrot (through her own witchcraft), Arthur pleads with Darrin to remove the spell. Endora then returns to normal and demands that Arthur stop his practical jokes, which Uncle Arthur accepts. Before leaving, Uncle Arthur gives Endora a pair of opera glasses. When she lowers them she has two black eyes.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Take Two Aspirins And Half A Pint Of Porpoise Milk
programme.desc: While Howard Norton shows the Stephens a black Peruvian rose, Samantha tells Darrin she feels ill and has lost her witchcraft. The doctor tells Samantha that her health is perfect. Gladys sees the doctor's car and brings some chicken soup. When square green spots appear on Samantha's face, Abner is sure the chicken soup is responsible. Aunt Clara arrives and lists the ingredients for a remedy. Darrin buys all the ingre-dients, except an ostrich feather, from Mr. Trigby, who caters to witches. Trying to take the ostrich feather from a woman's hat, Darrin is arrested but later released. Aunt Clara, after using witchcraft to produce an ostrich, tells Darrin she still needs four petals from a black Peruvian rose. Darrin is arrested when he tries to steal the petals from Mr. Norton's precious bloom. Finally, Aunt Clara concocts the remedy and cures Samantha. Later, Mr. Norton is astonished when he sees a window box filled with black Peruvian roses Samantha has produced by twitching her nose.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Despite Endora's demand that Samantha accompany her to a witches celebration of Halloween, Darrin insists that his wife stay at home to entertain Louise and Larry Tate, Jack Rogers, a client, and his wife, Phyllis. Disguising herself as a child in a gypsy costume, Endora hexes Darrin with a spell that will gradually turn him into a werewolf. When Samantha demands that her mother remove the spell, Endora tells her she can't remember the words. After the guests arrive, Darrin is forced to go out of the room from time to time to shave off the werewolf hair which is beginning to grow all over him. Finally, when dinner arrives, Darrin starts snarling and jumps through as open window. Larry and Jack, sure that Darrin is in werewolf costume, bring him back into the house. Darrin, fearful of what he might do, gets Samantha to lock him in the call closet. Endora reappears in a high fashion evening gown. When Samantha tells her she is behaving exactly like the stereotype of a witch she hates so much, Endora returns Darrin to his normal self. Later, Jack, certain that Endora is also garbed for Halloween, compliments her on her bizarre outfit. Endora gestures, and a lion's tail appears on Jack. Endora tells Darrin Jack won't notice it until he tries to remove his trousers.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry Tate invites Samantha and Darrin to a buffet for prospective client Charles Barlow. When they complain about the condition of their clothes, Aunt Clara uses magic to produce a dress for Samantha and a new suit for Darrin, who invites her along to the affair. Once there, Aunt Clara removes a fire hydrant so Darrin can park. At the party, Samantha's dress begins to vanish and Aunt Clara's other magical efforts begin to disintegrate. Agreeing to drop Barlow at his hotel, Darrin finds the hydrant has returned to its place beside the car. As a policeman approaches, Darrin's outer garments disappear. Aunt Clara's efforts to help result in chaos, with Barlow, Darrin and the policeman dressed in each other's clothing. Barlow leaves, vowing Darrin will never get his account, and still in his underwear, Darrin is jailed with Montague, an alcoholic. After Aunt Clara's attempts to clothe Darrin fail, Samantha goes to his cell with a suit of clothes. When Judge Crosetti hears Montague's mad account of a change of clothing in the cell, he releases Darrin. Larry Tate, having heard Barlow's equally wild story, decides his company is not interested in handling his account.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. Samantha tells Darrin she'll need lots of love to keep the hoofers away.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. When Samantha wonders whether the Stephens ' baby will look like his father, Endora turns Darrin into an eight-year-old. Returned to normal, Darrin goes to his office. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Aunt Clara tells Samantha and Endora she is hiding from warlock Hedley Partridge, because she fears her old beau will discover her magic no longer works. Seeing in Hedley a husband for Aunt Clara, who has become a problem, Endora invites him to the Stephens home. Samantha decides to make sure Aunt Clara's tricks work. Unaware of this, Aunt Clara is sure her gift is returned when she matches all of Hedley's tricks. When Samantha goes out of the room, Aunt Clara tries to follow Hedley's ro-mantic suggestion that they turn themselves into nightingales, but Hedley becomes an animal, while Aunt Clara's lower half disappears. Gladys Kravitz, who has become hysterical watching the strange happenings, drags Abner over to the Stephens house. When Samantha returns Aunt Clara and Hedley to normal, Aunt Clara is crushed to learn that Samantha helped her all along. Gladys skeptically accepts Abner's explanation that Hedley's magic was performed with the aid of wires. Aunt Clara and Hedley each admit that none of their tricks work as well as they used to. Promising to return, Hedley leaves. Aunt Clara tells Samantha his parting gift a rhinestone doorknob, is more precious than an engagement ring.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After an argument, Gladys Kravitz locks her husband out of their home. The Stephens invite Abner to spend the night at their place. Later, when it appears that Abner, using all his privileges as a guest, is more than satisfied with the arrangements and is making no effort to return to his own home, Darrin demands that Samantha take action. Not only is Samantha unsuccessful in all her attempts to effect a reconciliation, but she learns that Gladys wants a divorce. When all else fails, Samantha gets the idea of using sleep therapy to reunite the Kravitzes. Feeling that one of the happiest days of her life is the day a man proposes marriage, and a woman accepts him, Samantha projects Gladys and Abner in their dreams back to that day. Then she awakens them and each begins looking for the other. Later, as Samantha and Darrin look forward to spending an evening at home alone, the Kravitzes arrive to celebrate their reunion.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: As Darrin naps in the living room, Endora points out some of the unfortunate details of his face. Samantha at first protests when her mother, using witchcraft, changes Darrin's looks but then adds some touches of her own. Awakening, Darrin demands an explanation. Samantha can't explain why she and Endora were changing his features, and Darrin begins to worry. As the obsession grows, Samantha decides to build up her husband's ego. Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror att hon har tämjt Justin, men han har kanske inte kommit över Audrina än. När Holly ballar ur på ett event så tvingas Heidi ta upp hennes alkoholproblem med sin syster.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spelar svårfångad med Kristin, men hans plan går i stöpet. Hollys supande gör att Heidi och Stephanie ordnar en intervention. Brody och Jayde börjar slåss och tvingas tänka över sin vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin hamnar på hal is efter det att Kristin och Audrina till slut träffats. Det enda Heidi vill ha i födelsedagspresent är en bebis, men Spencer har siktet inställt på nåt helt annat.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody funderar på att börja dejta igen, men när de träffar Jayde inser de att tidpunkten är fel. Audrina och Justin diskuterar sin framtid, men det slutar inte som hon hoppats. Spencer tar till drastiska metoder mot Heidis bebisdrömmar.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin och Jayde hamnar i bråk när hon försöker att få tillbaka Brody. Heidi planerar att bli gravid vare sig Spencer vill det eller inte, och Audrina bearbetar det faktum att Justin fortfarande har känslor för Kristin.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vill inte bli ihop med Justin, men han ger sig inte utan kamp och Audrina gör slut med Justin för gott. Brody får kalla fötter när Jayde vill flytta in hos honom och Spencer har ångest över att Heidi kan vara gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin och Justin tar förhållandet till nästa nivå och Spencer konfronterar Heidi om gravtestet. Brody kanske fortfarande hyser känslor för Kristin efter det att Jayde talat ut om deras förhållande på en förlovningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Det blir inte roligt för Heidi att komma hem när mamma ogillar att hon gjort plastikkirurgi. Kristin och tjejerna åker till Miami för Super Bowl-helgen, men resan går snett när hennes festande börjar oroa Audrina, Lo och Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: När det börjar gå rykten om Kristins festande får Stephanie skulden. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille, men det hindrar inte Brody från att jaga henne. Spencer blir upprörd när han springer på Stephanie på Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi har fest för sin granne, men festen hamnar i skymundan när Spencer blir arg på Holly. Kristin tycker att Audrina ska vara med Ryan och försöker sen komma närmare Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidis och Spencers beteende tvingar deras vänner och familjer att göra ett svårt val. Kristin och Brody får ihop det, men båda vill hellre vara singel. Ryan gör Audrina besviken när han aldrig dyker upp trots att de ska gå ut.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody riskerar sin vänskap med Kristin när han börjar gå ut med en ny tjej. Lo ordnar en dubbeldejt åt Stephanie. Ryan ger Audrinas vänner en ny chans.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin har svårt att gå vidare från Brody. Audrina råkar på Justin och börjar tveka över sitt förhållande med Ryan. Lo slår upp en bekantskap med Brodys nya flickvän.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nya kärlek gör Kristin till sin fiende när hon tar med en gammal rival till Kristins fest. Ryan kommer hem från turnén, men Audrina berättar inte att hon träffade Justin medan han var bortrest.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas förhållande med Ryan sätts på prov när han träffar Justin för första gången. Brody tar Kristins parti när Aliie börjar bråka med henne. Stephanie går på en andra dejt, men den är en besvikelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: I samma veva som Audrina gör slut med Ryan överraskar Justin henne på födelsedagen. McKaelas vän Allie ställer till mer bråk för Kristin. Brody säger ett sanningens ord till Justin.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: När hela gruppen åker till Costa Rica för att surfa gör blir Brody svartsjuk när Kristin får ihop det med en bartender. Audrina försöker förneka sin attraktion till Justin, och Stephanie passar inte in i djungelmiljön.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody talar ut och hon berättar att hon vill att de försöker på nytt. Heidis mamma besöker LA i hopp om en återförening. Lo och hennes pojkvän firar årsdag, och Stephanie börjar dejta en ny kille.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står inför ett stort beslut som även påverkar Brody. Audrina gör slut med Justin. Lo vet inte om hon är redo för nästa steg med sin pojkvän och Stephanie tror att hon äntligen funnit den rätte.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: En nystart för detta kompisgäng när de återvänder till The Hills och träffar varann för första gången på länge. De ställs inför nya utmaningar, men gamla rivaliteter och romanser ställer till det. Ibland är det förflutna inte förflutet.

programme.desc: Stephanie försöker att lappa ihop sin relation med brodern Spencer, Mischa säger ifrån till Perez Hilton som mobbade henne när hon var i stjärnljuset. Det slår gnistor mellan Audrina och Justin, men Justin verkar ha fått ögonen på en till.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: På en åker utanför Enköping hittas en ung man död. Vid första anblicken ser det ut som om han lagt sig ner för att vila – men när polisen granskar kroppen upptäcker de vad som tros vara en skottskada.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: I juli 2022 skakas Mölndal när en död man upptäcks halvt avklädd, brännmärkt och med en bandspelare placerad på kroppen. Polisen misstänker att något mycket mer oroande än ett vanligt mord har skett.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: På kvällen den 21 april 2021 får Jönköpingspolisen ett samtal från en kvinna som vill anmäla att hennes man är borta. Nästa dag hittas mannen död, gömd i naturreservatet Dumme Mosse.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: Natten till den 13 februari 2023 skakas lilla byn Malå i norra Sverige av en brutal attack. När polis börjar nysta i fallet framkommer mörka hemligheter och misstankar mot oväntade personer.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: När småbarnsmamman Beata försvinner i september 2021 startas en massiv sökinsats där både polisen och allmänheten deltar. Men trots flera spår som kan kopplas till Beata så förblir hon försvunnen.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: År 1999 brinner Knut Øyvind Moes hus ner till grunden i Valdres. Två dagar senare hittas hans kvarlevor i brandruinerna, och det visar sig att han sköts till döds före branden.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 317
programme.desc: Tindra och Linn provar babymassage för att bota Tindras kolik. Natalie och Joline har besökt logopeden för att utveckla Jolines tal.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 318
programme.desc: Alicia följer med när Natalie ska tatuera en ros på handen. Linn och Marcus har bjudit in till parmiddag. Julia har fått sponsrade saker till Milan, bland annat en ny overall som Milan ska fotas i.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 319
programme.desc: Julia och Milan målar med fingerfärg och Julia berättar om relationen med Dennis. Linn och Marcus försöker få ett gipsavtryck av Tindras hand och fot innan hon blir för stor.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 320
programme.desc: För Fayme är bästa stunden på dagen när pappa Moltas kommer hem från jobbet. Då springer alla barnen till pappa och Fayme kan äntligen pusta ut. Linn, Marcus och Tindra åker på semester till Marcus familj.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 321
programme.desc: Linn, Marcus och Tindra åker till Brunneby Musteri. De pratar om hur de träffades och alla lögner de lindade in sig i för deras föräldrar. Julia och hennes vänner leker med Milan i parken och han njuter av all uppmärksamhet.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 322
programme.desc: Julia försöker få vardagen att gå ihop med tre olika jobb och att vara ensamstående mamma varannan vecka. Colin, som är väldigt klädintresserad ska äntligen få shoppa med Fayme.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 323
programme.desc: Julia är lycklig över hur snabbt Milans utveckling går framåt och på söndagar är det dags för myskväll. Då kan Julia inte riktigt hålla sig från att ge Milan nästan allt han vill ha.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 324
programme.desc: Fayme och familjen åker till ett lekland och Fayme ser äntligen sin chans att få ge igen på barnen för allt de utsätter henne för där hemma. Natalie är nervös när hon rider med sin kompis.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 325

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: Mitch Rappin kihlattu kuoli terrori-iskussa Ibizan-lomalla. Kostohimoinen Mitch etsii terroristit käsiinsä, mutta USA:n joukot ehtivät tappaa heidät ensin. Mitch kuitenkin värvätään CIA:n terrorisminvastaiseen salaiseen yksikköön. Sitä johtaa kylmän sodan veteraani ja legendaarinen agentti Stan Hurley. Kun eräs agentti kääntää takkia, Mitch ja Hurley lähtevät pitkälle matkalle halki maailman estääkseen katastrofaalisen suunnitelman toteutumisen. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2017.

programme.title: Drive-Away Dolls
programme.desc: Ethan Coenin ja Tricia Cooken kirjoittama komedia kertoo estottomasta vapaasta sielusta Jamiesta, joka suree erottuaan taas tyttöystävästään, ja hänen varautuneesta ystävästään Marianista, jonka on rentouduttava. Etsiessään uutta alkua kaksikko lähtee automatkalle Tallahasseehen, mutta asiat menevät nopeasti pieleen, kun he kohtaavat joukon toheloita rikollisia. Trilleri vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: Chaos Walking
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuuden maailmassa Todd Hewitt (Tom Holland) löytää metsästä mysteerisen lentoaluksellaan pakkolaskun tehneen tytön Violan (Daisy Ridley). Viola huomaa yllätyksekseen laskeutuneensa planeetalle, josta kaikki naiset ovat kadonneet. Jäljelle jääneet miehet ovat puolestaan altistuneet voimalle nimeltä "Ääni", joka saattaa miesten pienimmätkin ajatukset ääneen kaikkien kuultaville. Viola huomaa pian, että miesten hallitsemassa maailmassa hänen henkensä naisena on vaarassa. Todd päättää auttaa Violaa pakenemaan. Kaksikon pakomatka käynnistää tapahtumaketjun, joka paljastaa uuden yhteiskunnan synkimmät salaisuudet. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2021.

programme.title: U-571
programme.desc: Toinen maailmansota on käynnissä ja amerikkalaisjoukkue saa tehtäväkseen varastaa Enigma-koodauslaitteen saksalaisten sukellusveneestä. Toiminta vuodelta 2000.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Paleontologi tohtori Alan Grant saa houkuttelevan tarjouksen ryhtyä oppaaksi rikkaalle pariskunnalle Isla Sorna -dinosaurussaaren ylilennolle. Vastoin Grantin tahtoa retkikunta laskeutuukin dinosaurusten asuttamalle saarelle, josta pois pääsy ei onnistukaan aivan yhtä helposti. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2001.

programme.title: Outolintu-sarja: Kapinallinen
programme.desc: Tris ja Neljä ovat nyt karkureita Terävien eliitin vallanhimoisen johtajan Jeaninen jahdatessa heitä herkeämättä. Juostessaan aikaa vastaan heidän täytyy selvittää mitä suojellakseen Trisin perhe uhrasi elämänsä ja miksi Terävien johtajat tekevät kaikkensa pysäyttääkseen heidät. Amerikkalainen Sci-Fi vuodelta 2015.

programme.title: Armoton maa
programme.desc: Moderni lännenelokuva entisestä pyssysankarista, joka joutuu tarttumaan jälleen aseisiin, kun korruptoitunut seriffi uhkaa häntä ja hänen karjanhoitajiaan. Amerikkalainen lännenelokuva 2003.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Tänä päivänä Jurassic World ottaa vastaan kymmeniä tuhansia kävijöitä, mutta puiston nähtävyyksien takana piilee uhka: geneettisesti muunneltu dinosaurus, jolla on julmia kykyjä. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2015.

programme.title: Outolintu-sarja: Uskollinen
programme.desc: Outolintu-sarjan kolmas osa Uskollinen vie Trisin ja Neljän entistäkin vaarallisempaan uuteen maailmaan. Tris ja Neljä joutuvat pakenemaan Chicagon rajojen ulkopuolelle - kauas perheestään, kodistaan ja kaikesta tuntemastaan - ensimmäistä kertaa elämässään. Rajan toisella puolella heille paljastuu uusia järkyttäviä totuuksia ja Trisin ja Neljän on päätettävä nopeasti kehen he voivat luottaa koko ihmiskuntaa uhkaavan sodan syttyessä kaupungin muurien tuolla puolen. Selvitäkseen hengissä Tris joutuu mahdottomien rohkeutta, uskollisuutta, uhrautuvaisuutta ja rakkautta koskevien päätösten eteen. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2016.

programme.title: American made

programme.desc: Clive Owenin ja Naomi Wattsin tähdittämä trilleri Interpolin agentista ja piirisyyttäjästä, jotka yrittävät saada korruptoituneen pankin oikeuteen. Vastapuoli ei kaihda mitään keinoja. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2009.

programme.desc: Beau on työllensä omistautunut "linjamies", eli voimajohtojen korjaaja ja ylläpitäjä. programme.desc: Tänä päivänä Jurassic World ottaa vastaan kymmeniä tuhansia kävijöitä, mutta puiston nähtävyyksien takana piilee uhka: geneettisesti muunneltu dinosaurus, jolla on julmia kykyjä. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2015.

programme.title: Outolintu-sarja: Uskollinen
programme.desc: Outolintu-sarjan kolmas osa Uskollinen vie Trisin ja Neljän entistäkin vaarallisempaan uuteen maailmaan. Tris ja Neljä joutuvat pakenemaan Chicagon rajojen ulkopuolelle - kauas perheestään, kodistaan ja kaikesta tuntemastaan - ensimmäistä kertaa elämässään. Rajan toisella puolella heille paljastuu uusia järkyttäviä totuuksia ja Trisin ja Neljän on päätettävä nopeasti kehen he voivat luottaa koko ihmiskuntaa uhkaavan sodan syttyessä kaupungin muurien tuolla puolen. Selvitäkseen hengissä Tris joutuu mahdottomien rohkeutta, uskollisuutta, uhrautuvaisuutta ja rakkautta koskevien päätösten eteen. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2016.

programme.title: Maailman ympäri 80 päivässä
programme.desc: Herrasmies Fog lyö vetoa, että hän pystyy kiertämään maapallon 80 päivässä. Palvelijansa Passepartoun ja tämän parhaan ystävän Tikon kanssa Fog ajautuu moniin jännittäviin seikkailuihin. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2004.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Kaatunut valtakunta
programme.desc: On kulunut kolme vuotta siitä, kun teemapuisto ja luksuslomakohde Jurassic World tuhoutui dinosaurusten päästyä valloilleen. Isla Nublar on hylätty ja hävityksestä selviytyneet dinosaurukset elävät villeinä viidakoissa. Kun saaren uinuva tulivuori alkaa näyttää elonmerkkejä, Owen ja Claire aloittavat kampanjan, jonka tarkoituksena on pelastaa dinosaurukset uuden sukupuuton uhalta. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: Ufo
programme.desc: Epäselvät ilmiöt ovat vuosikymmeniä olleet synkkä varjo USA:n hallitukselle. Nuori opiskelija, hänen tyttöystävänsä ja matematiikan professori sukeltavat mysteerin sisään – ja FBI tulee perästä. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Natsien käsistä pelastettu paholainen vaihtaa puolta ja ryhtyy taistelemaan pimeyden voimia vastaan. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2004.

programme.title: Black Sea
programme.desc: Entinen sukkellusveneen kapteeni ottaa tehtäväkseen löytää piilotetun aarteen syvältä Mustanmeren pohjasta. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2014.

programme.title: Dragged Across Concrete
programme.desc: DRAGGED ACROSS CONCRETE kertoo poliisiparista, joka hyllytetään, kun media saa käsiinsä videon, jolla miehet kohtelevat pidätettävää varsin kovakouraisesti. Kun rahat ja vaihtoehdot ovat vähissä, katkerat poliisit heittäytyvät rikollisen alamaailman pariin. Varjoisat kujat voivat yllättää kokeneenkin konkarin. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: The International
programme.desc: Clive Owenin ja Naomi Wattsin tähdittämä trilleri Interpolin agentista ja piirisyyttäjästä, jotka yrittävät saada korruptoituneen pankin oikeuteen. Vastapuoli ei kaihda mitään keinoja. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2009.

programme.title: Life on the Line
programme.desc: Beau on työllensä omistautunut "linjamies", eli voimajohtojen korjaaja ja ylläpitäjä. Hän on menettänyt veljensä voimajohto-onnettomuudessa ja pitää nyt huolta veljentyttärestään Baileysta. Beau saa yllätyksekseen kuulla, että Bailey tapailee Duncania, nuorta linjamiestä. Linjamieskaksikko lähetetään yhdessä matkaan koettelevan lumimyrskyn keskelle, mutta Duncan ei tiedä Baileyn olevan sairaalassa. Pian kello alkaa käydä heitä vastaan, ja Beaun on pakko luottaa nuoreen kollegaansa sairaalan kärsiessä sähkökatkosta. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2015.

programme.desc: Barb (Emma Thompson) eksyy Minnesotan lumimyrskyssä erään järven läheiselle sivutielle. Hän saa tietää, että murhaa suunnitteleva epätoivoinen pariskunta on siepannut erään nuoren naisen. Eristyksissä katvealueen keskellä tämä epätodennäköinen sankaritar ymmärtää olevansa nuoren naisen ainoa toivo selviytyä. Toimintatrilleri vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: Robots
programme.desc: 'Lähitulevaisuuden Amerikkaan sijoittuvassa elokuvassa naistenmies Charles (Jack Whitehall) ja kullankaivaja Elaine (Shailene Woodley) huijaavat ihmisiä suhteisiin omien laittomien robottikopioidensa kanssa. Kun he tietämättään yrittävät huijata toisiaan, robotit rakastuvat ja karkaavat. Charles ja Elaine joutuvat yhdistämään voimansa löytääkseen robottikaksoisolentonsa, ennen kuin heidän salaisuutensa paljastuu viranomaisille. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2023.

programme.title: No Man of God
programme.desc: Sarjamurhaaja Ted Bundy kylvi kauhua 1970-luvulla brutaaleilla ja häikäilemättömillä rikoksillaan. FBI-agentti Bill Hagmaier päättää yrittäää päästä sarjamurhaajan pään sisälle ja yrittää ymmärtää, mikä tämän ajoi karmeisiin tekoihin. Elokuva kertoo kiehtovasta siteestä, joka miesten välille heidän tapaamistensa myötä syntyi. Elokuva perustuu arkistomateriaaliin Hagmaierin ja Bundyn keskusteluista. No Man of God kertoo kuolemaantuomitun murhaajan viimeisistä elinvuosista. Päärooleissa nähdään Elijah Wood ja Luke Kirby. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2021.

programme.title: Jane Austen -lukupiiri
programme.desc: Romanttinen komedia, jossa kuusi henkilöä kokoontuu keskustelemaan Jane Austenin romaaneista. He löytävät kirjojen hahmoista paljon itseään. Amerikkalainen romanttinen komedia vuodelta 2007.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: Oscar-voittaja Angelina Jolie on maailman suurin oopperalaulaja Maria Callas tässä kriitikoiden ylistämän ohjaaja Pablo Larrainin tositarinallisessa draamassa. Elokuva seuraa yhdysvaltalaiskreikkalaista sopraanoa, joka vetäytyy Pariisiin loistokkaan ja myrskyisän julkisuudessa vietetyn elämänsä jälkeen. Hän viettää Pariisissa elämänsä viimeiset päivät ja kohtaa sekä identiteettinsä että elämänsä. Italialainen draama vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: Two Night Stand
programme.desc: Toisinaan sitä kaipaa vain yhden yön juttua ja sen jälkeen tekee mieli poistua mahdollisimman nopeasti takavasemmalle! Entä jos sankka lumimyrsky on tukkinut kaikki kaikki pakotiet, ja on mahdotonta poistua nolosta tilanteesta? Alecilla ja Meganilla ei ole juuri mitään yhteistä, mutta satunnainen yhden yön juttu muuttuukin aivan muuksi, kun he voi muuta kuin ryhtyä tutustumaan toisiinsa! Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2014.

programme.title: Pako rajan yli
programme.desc: Gerdan ja Oton vanhemmat pidätetään, kun heidän kellarissa piileksii kaksi juutalaislasta. Vanhempien ollessa poissa jää Gerdan ja Oton vastuulle saada Sarah ja Daniel turvallisesti rajan yli Ruotsiin. Norjalainen draama vuodelta 2020.

programme.title: Safe Haven
programme.desc: Kun Katie laskeutuu bussista syrjäisessä Southportissa, kukaan ei tiedä hänen alkuperäänsä. Kaunis mutta sulkeutunut tyttö ystävystyy pikkuhiljaa naapurin Jon kanssa. Hän myös haluamattaan rakastuu yksinhuoltajaisä Alexiin. Katien salaisuus on paljastumassa pian. Hänen on valittava, lähteekö hän pakomatkalle vai kohtaako hän menneisyyden. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2013.

programme.title: Long Shot – mahdoton yhtälö
programme.desc: Kun Fred tapaa jälleen nuoruudenihastuksensa Charlotte Fieldin, hän hurmaa naisen heti. On vain yksi pieni ongelma – Charlotte on nyt ulkoministeri ja yksi maailman vaikutusvaltaisimmista naisista. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Veitset esiin - Kaikki ovat epäiltyjä
programme.desc: Tunnettu rikoskirjailija Harlan Thrombey löydetään kuolleena kartanostaan hänen syntymäpäiväjuhliensa jälkeen. Utelias ja tyylikäs etsivä Benoit Blanc ilmaantuu paikalle tutkimaan tapausta. Etsivä Blanc sukkuloi Harlanin ristiriitaisen perheen ja uskollisen palvelusväen välillä. Harhautusten ja itsekkäiden valheiden keskellä hän pyrkiipaljastamaan Harlanin murhan taustalla olevan totuuden. Amerikkalainen thriller vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Silmänkääntäjä
programme.desc: Taikuri Eisenheim ihastuttaa yleisöään huikeilla esityksillään 1900-luvun alun Wienissä. Kruununprinssi Leopold tahtoo kuitenkin tehdä lopun hänen tempuistaan ja panee poliisipäällikkö Uhlin asialle. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2006.

programme.title: Veteen piirretty viiva
programme.desc: Sotamies Robert Witt on karkuri, joka elää rauhallista elämää Tyynenmeren saarella paikallisten asukkaiden kanssa. Laivasto kuitenkin vangitsee hänet, ja hän saa komppanianvääpeliltä ankarat nuhteet ja käskyn palata rintamalle välittömästi. Wittin ja muiden noustessa maihin jatko on epävarma. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 1998. The Thin Red Line

programme.desc: 1860-luvun San Franciscossa itsenäinen ja omapäinen Vivienne (Vicky Krieps) aloittaa suhteen tanskalaisen siirtolaisen Holger Olsenin (Viggo Mortensen) kanssa. He matkustavat Nevadaan Olsenin vaatimattomaan kotiin, ja aloittavat yhteisen elämän. Mutta sisällissota erottaa heidät, ja Viviennen on selvittävä yksin kaupungissa, jota hallitsevat korruptoituneet poliitikot ja raa'at rikolliset. Hän on kuitenkin päättänyt pärjätä häikäilemättömien miesten hallitsemassa maailmassa. Kun Olsen vihdoin palaa kotiin, pariskunnan on tutustuttava toisiinsa uudelleen ja hyväksyttävä toisensa sellaisina kuin he nyt ovat. Kanadalainen western vuodelta 2023.

programme.title: Diana's Wedding
programme.desc: Komedia Diana's Wedding on kunnianosoitus niille, jotka heittäytyvät päättömästi rakkauteen. Kertomus kahdesta, jotka eivät koskaan lakkaa rakastamasta toisiaan, vaikka eivät ajoittain kestä nähdäkään toisiaan. On heinäkuun 29. päivä 1981. Lady Diana Spencer astelee pitkin kirkon käytävää yhdessä prinssi Charlesin kanssa St Paulin katedraalissa Lontoossa. Samana päivänä pidetään eräät toisetkin häät, Borregaard-yhtiön ruokalassa. Siellä vietetään vastavihityn parin Livin ja Terjen hääjuhlaa. Vaunuissa makaa heidän vastasyntynyt tyttärensä Diana, joka tulee näkemään kaikenlaista tulevina vuosina. Diana seuraa sivusta Livin ja Terjen avioliittoa, vauvasta lähtien aina kotoa pois muuttonsa asti. Hän näkee maailman surkeimmat vanhemmat, jotka eivät millään tavalla pane parastaan. Kun sitten 30 vuoden jälkeen juhlitaan häitä ruotsalaisessa kartanossa, joissa morsiamena on Diana, ovat hermot kireällä. Ja pahempaa seuraa. Norjalainen draamakomedia vuodelta 2020.

programme.desc: Kun Katie laskeutuu bussista syrjäisessä Southportissa, kukaan ei tiedä hänen alkuperäänsä. Kaunis mutta sulkeutunut tyttö ystävystyy pikkuhiljaa naapurin Jon kanssa. Hän myös haluamattaan rakastuu yksinhuoltajaisä Alexiin. Katien salaisuus on paljastumassa pian. Hänen on valittava, lähteekö hän pakomatkalle vai kohtaako hän menneisyyden. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2013.

programme.title: Long Shot – mahdoton yhtälö
programme.desc: Kun Fred tapaa jälleen nuoruudenihastuksensa Charlotte Fieldin, hän hurmaa naisen heti. On vain yksi pieni ongelma – Charlotte on nyt ulkoministeri ja yksi maailman vaikutusvaltaisimmista naisista. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Veitset esiin - Kaikki ovat epäiltyjä
programme.desc: Tunnettu rikoskirjailija Harlan Thrombey löydetään kuolleena kartanostaan hänen syntymäpäiväjuhliensa jälkeen. Utelias ja tyylikäs etsivä Benoit Blanc ilmaantuu paikalle tutkimaan tapausta. Etsivä Blanc sukkuloi Harlanin ristiriitaisen perheen ja uskollisen palvelusväen välillä. Harhautusten ja itsekkäiden valheiden keskellä hän pyrkiipaljastamaan Harlanin murhan taustalla olevan totuuden. Amerikkalainen thriller vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Agentit Jay ja Kay yhdistävät voimansa taistelussa vaarallisia konnia vastaan galaksin menestyneimmässä scifi-komediassa. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 1997.

programme.title: After
programme.desc: Tessa Young on 18-vuotias college-opiskelija, jolla on mutkaton elämä, huolehtivainen äiti ja kiltti poikaystävä. Hänen elämänsä kulkee suunnitelmien mukaisesti, kunnes hän tapaa röyhkeän ja töykeän Hardinin, joka sekoittaa pakan. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Tahraton mieli
programme.desc: Joel järkyttyy kuullessaan, että hänen tyttöystävänsä Clementine on poistanut heidän myrskyisän suhteensa muististaan. Epätoivoisena hän ottaa yhteyttä menetelmän keksijään, tri Howard Mierzwiakiin, pyyhkiäkseen omankin muistinsa. Mutta kun muistot Clementinesta alkavat hämärtyä, Joel tajuaa kuinka paljon hän tätä yhä rakastaa. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2004.

programme.title: Neiti Peregrinen koti eriskummallisille lapsille
programme.desc: Jacob Portman on amerikkalainen teini, joka lähetetään syrjäiseen orpokotiin Walesiin. Orpokodin johtajalla Alma Peregrinellä on salaisia kykyjä. Jakelle selviää, että niin hänellä kuin muillakin lapsilla on jokin yliluonnollinen taito tulen hallinnasta kuolleiden herättämiseen. Oppilaita vaanivat hirviöt, jotka tahtovat syödä heidän silmänsä saadakseen ihmisyytensä takaisin, mutta neiti Pregrine neuvoo, miten oppilaat voivat puolustaa itseään ja taikakouluaan. Iso-Britannia, seikkailuelokuva, 2016. Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children

programme.desc: Andy Sachs on saanut himoitun työn muotilehden päätoimittajan Miranda Priestlyn assistenttina. Mirandan heittopussina olo saattaa kuitenkin koitua Andyn kuolemaksi! Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2006.

programme.desc: Eleanor The Great -elokuvassa June Squibb herättää elävästi eloon nokkelan ja ylpeän hankalan 94-vuotiaan Eleanor Morgensteinin, joka on kokenut järkyttävän menetyksen ja kertoo tarinan, joka alkaa elää omaa vaarallista elämäänsä. Scarlett Johanssonin ohjaajadebyytti käsittelee koomisesti ja terävästi sitä, miten kuulemistamme tarinoista tulee kertomiamme tarinoita. Draama vuodelta 2025.

programme.desc: FBI-agentti Terry Husk kiirehtii pysäyttääkseen ryöstöjen sarjan, joka terrorisoi Tyynenmeren luoteisrannikkoa. Nämä eivät kuitenkaan ole tavallisia ryöstöjä – niiden avulla rahoitetaan hallituksen vastaista salaliittoa. Yhdysvaltalainen rikosjännäri vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: The Fall Guy
programme.desc: Oscar®-ehdokas Ryan Gosling (Barbie) näyttelee Colt Seaversia, kovia kokenutta sijaisnäyttelijää, joka huolehtii fyysisestä ja henkisestä terveydestään lähdettyään alalta vuotta aiemmin. Hän joutuu takaisin töihin, kun hänen entinen tyttöystävänsä Jody Moreno, jota näyttelee Golden Globe -palkittu Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer), tarvitsee apua ohjaamansa suurelokuvan tähtinäyttelijän kadottua. Toimintakomedia vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: Kolme muskettisoturia: D'Artagnan
programme.desc: Louvresta Buckinghamin palatsiin, Pariisin katuojista La Rochellen piiritykseen... Uskonsodat ja brittien hyökkäyksen uhka ovat jakaneet kuningaskunnan. Kourallinen miehiä ja naisia käy taisteluun ja sitoo kohtalonsa Ranskan kohtaloon. Toimintaseikkailu vuodelta 2023.

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Celine Songin herkkä ja hienovarainen ohjausdebyytti Past Lives sai maailmanensi-iltansa Sundancen elokuvafestivaaleilla valloittaen sekä yleisön että kriitikoiden sydämet. Elokuvaa on ylistetty paitsi yhdeksi vuoden parhaista elokuvista, myös vaikuttavimmaksi rakkaustarinaksi vuosikausiin. Lapsuudenystävät Nora ja Hae Sung joutuvat eroon toisistaan, kun Noran perhe muuttaa pois Etelä-Koreasta. Kaksikymmentä vuotta myöhemmin he tapaavat New Yorkissa ja viettävät viikon yhdessä: onko olemassa ikiaikainen kohtalo, joka solmii sieluja yhteen? Past Lives on sydäntä särkevä moderni romanssi elämän risteyskohdista. Päärooleissa Norana ja Hae Sungina loistavat Greta Lee (Russian Doll, The Morning Show) ja Yoo Teo (Decision to Leave, Leto). Noran aviomiehenä Arthurina hienossa sivuroolissa nähdään John Magaro (Big Short). Romanttinen draama vuodelta 2023.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: BETTER MAN kertoo Robbie Williamsin tarinan lapsuudesta Take That-tähteyteen ja ennätyksiä rikkovaksi sooloartistiksi. Michael Graceyn (The Greatest Showman) ohjaama elokuva näyttää nousun, romahduksen ja paluun Robbien näkökulmasta, vangiten hänen huumorinsa ja periksiantamattomuutensa. Elokuva käsittelee myös tähtitaivaan tuomia haasteita. Elämäkerrallinen musiikkielokuva vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: No Hard Feelings
programme.desc: Jennifer Lawrence on tuottanut ja tähdittää elokuvaa No Hard Feelings, joka on hilpeän hauska ja särmikäs komedia Gene Stupnitskylta (ohjaus: Good Boys, toinen käsikirjoittaja: Bad Teacher).Maddie (Lawrence) uskoo nyt ratkaisevansa rahaongelmansa löytäessään kiehtovan työpaikkailmoituksen: varakkaat helikopterivanhemmat etsivät 19-vuotiaalle Percy-pojalleen deittikumppania, joka toisi tämän pois kuorestaan ennen collegeen menoa. Mutta kömpelö Percy osoittautuu suuremmaksi haasteeksi kuin Maddie uskoikaan, ja aika käy vähiin. Hänellä on yksi kesä aikaa tehdä Percystä mies, tai muuten kaikki on menetetty. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2023. N: Jennifer Lawrence, Andrew Barth Feldman, Matthew Broderick, Laura Benanti, Natalie Morales (I)

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In America
programme.desc: The epic crime drama directed by Sergio Leone that chronicles decades of friendship, betrayal, and ambition in New York’s underworld. Spanning from the early 1900s to the 1960s, the film follows David “Noodles” Aaronson, played by Robert De Niro, and his rise from a small-time street kid to a powerful gangster. Told through a haunting, non-linear narrative, the story explores loyalty, lost love, and the heavy cost of power. With its sweeping cinematography and unforgettable score by Ennio Morricone, the film stands as a melancholic, operatic reflection on memory and regret.

programme.title: The Princess and the Bodyguard
programme.desc: On her 35th birthday, Lexi discovers that she will suddenly have to give up her normal life in New York and become who she always secretly was… a royal Princess. She has two weeks to come to terms with this, reveal her true identity to her best friend, and find a suitable date for the royal gala, where she will be introduced to the world. All under the watchful eye of her handsome but infuriating bodyguard, Noah.

programme.title: Made for You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she’s afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed! Jillian’s plan is to sell it as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: En besetning av miniatyraliens styr et romskip som har menneskelig form. Mens de prøver å redde planeten sin, møter aliens et nytt problem, da skipet blir forelsket i en jordisk kvinne.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Layla Bennett has it all figured out, her own place, a thriving career and a loving fiancé. She co-hosts morning show Wake Up Chicago! Alongside her charming but sometimes irritating colleague Derek Dray. They have different working styles. She likes to be spontaneous and improvise on air, while he’s more of a stick to the script guy. When they’re given the bombshell of caring for a baby together, it’s their worst nightmare…But as they juggle night feeds and nap times with their hectic lives, they can’t deny the growing chemistry. Is this unexpected arrival all they needed to realise they were meant to be?

programme.title: A Slice of Romance
programme.desc: When unlucky in love PR Executive Mikayla meets coffee shop owner and aspiring pastry chef Austin, the pair strike a deal: she'll taste his desserts if he gives her dating advice. Little did they know sparks would fly between them.

programme.title: The Dating List
programme.desc: Career driven Abby agrees to help her busy boss find the man of her dreams, but she encounters a dilemma when she starts falling for the same man her boss approves of dating.

programme.title: A Vineyard Romance
programme.desc: When Seattle magazine writer Samantha Hart is sent home to write an article about the wedding destination of Hawthorne Vineyards, she discovers the ex who broke her heart not only runs the vineyard, but he's about to get married there.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Theresa, a young woman, takes her boyfriend, Simon, home to introduce him to her parents and share the surprise of their engagement. There's another twist: Simon is white.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Spoof of romantic comedies which focuses on a woman, her crush, her parents, and her father.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programme.desc: Just three days out from their wedding day, Jess and Max are ready to call it quits from the out-of-control planning. They visit Billie, the owner of a wedding donation company, specializing in donating leftover wedding elements to those in need. However Max’s brother Charlie will stop at nothing to keep them together, he enlists the help of Billie to ensure this meant-to-be couple gets hitched once and for all.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programme.desc: Just three days out from their wedding day, Jess and Max are ready to call it quits from the out-of-control planning. They visit Billie, the owner of a wedding donation company, specializing in donating leftover wedding elements to those in need. However Max’s brother Charlie will stop at nothing to keep them together, he enlists the help of Billie to ensure this meant-to-be couple gets hitched once and for all.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is

programme.title: The Beauty of Love
programme.desc: Emma has built a successful lifestyle website that she puts her heart and soul into called Classically Emma. But when her numbers start trending down, she thinks she might've found her fix in a partnership with ambitious Jill.

programme.title: A Country Romance
programme.desc: When Sarah Kress learns her family’s vineyard is up for sale, she leaves her busy urban life and visits her hometown to help with the sale and have her last harvest. With the help of handsome neighbor Gabe, huge challenge becomes fun as she and Gabe fall in love. But when the job is done, Sarah must decide whether to return to her fast-paced life or follow her heart.

programme.title: The Song to My Heart
programme.desc: After a childhood on the road with her legendary singer-songwriter father, organic teashop owner Bonnie Highstreet, wants nothing to do with the music business, but when she helps music sensation, Ryder Jamison, develop lyrics for his new solo album, she rekindles her long abandoned dream and falls in love.

programme.title: Forever in My Heart
programme.desc: Jenna and Charlie found love in Ireland but their dreams drove them apart. Five years later, they reunite and Jenna has to decide where her heart belongs—back home or in the Emerald Isle.

programme.title: Cheer Squad Secrets
programme.desc: A mother helps her daughter become captain of the cheerleading squad only to discover that someone is giving the daughter mysterious supplements and will do anything, including murder, to cover it up.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: When an engaged romance novelist is teamed with a Navy man as research for her latest book, she is taken aback by his boisterous personality and egotistical nature. However, as her research brings them closer together, she discovers there’s more to him than meets the eye. Will she choose the man she thought she loved or the real-life embodiment of her fictional hero?

programme.title: A Murderer Upstairs
programme.desc: Inspired by true events. A mother protects her stepdaughter after the teenager witnesses the murder of her best friend, but is soon forced to come to grips with the terrifying possibility that her stepdaughter could be the real killer.

programme.title: Romance Retreat
programme.desc: After a big breakup, journalist Dana Willingham finds herself alone and stuck at a couple’s yoga retreat while the biggest story of her career breaks far away. And she doesn’t even like yoga! But maybe the universe has put her here for a reason, because the handsome loner staying at the lodge turns out to be Stefan Gonzales, the tech guru at the center of the scandal. As she gains his trust to expose him, she finds herself falling in love with him. Now she must use the lessons from yoga to choose: the perfect story or the perfect man?

programme.title: Made for You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she’s afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed! Jillian’s plan is to sell it as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse.

programme.title: A Bride's Nightmare
programme.desc: When Leah is kidnapped on the day of her wedding by her fiancé’s delusional ex-girlfriend Kayla, she does everything within her power to escape. But once she does, she begins to question whether Kayla was ever really delusional or if she was just trying to save her life.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In America
programme.desc: The epic crime drama directed by Sergio Leone that chronicles decades of friendship, betrayal, and ambition in New York’s underworld. Spanning from the early 1900s to the 1960s, the film follows David “Noodles” Aaronson, played by Robert De Niro, and his rise from a small-time street kid to a powerful gangster. Told through a haunting, non-linear narrative, the story explores loyalty, lost love, and the heavy cost of power. With its sweeping cinematography and unforgettable score by Ennio Morricone, the film stands as a melancholic, operatic reflection on memory and regret.
